prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for an original 2D chibi colony-defense game. Match reference artwork precisely: fine dark brown outlines, compact cute anime heads, layered cel shading, muted colors, natural low bangs and small eyes. Actual transparent background, no fog, backdrop, text, grid lines, labels or shadows. NO ARMS or hands. No realistic anatomy, no animal ears, no weapons. Each cell separated by generous transparent margins, consistent scale and registration. This is a component atlas, not full-character outfit combinations. HEAD-ONLY atlas, exactly 3 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS. Every column is ONE identity, repeated in four views. ROW 1: front facing viewer; ROW 2: strict right-facing profile, nose points RIGHT; ROW 3: back of head, NO face or eyes visible; ROW 4: strict left-facing profile, nose points LEFT. Front/profile/back must depict the SAME haircut and colors in each column, not four different characters. Include hair, face and small neck stub, but absolutely no torso, shoulders, clothing, helmets or bodies. Long hair may extend to neck only in this head atlas (long rear locks will be separate). Maintain exactly these identities: Column 1 approved dark-teal straight hair with low swept layered fringe, soft oval face, teal eyes. Column 2 approved textured short brown hair, rounded-square jaw, amber eyes. Column 3 approved wavy ash-silver bob, rounded cheek face, violet eyes. Preserve the approved facial identity and hairline from the reference 'after' examples.

HEADLESS BODY-ONLY atlas, exactly 4 COLUMNS x 3 ROWS. One compact average chibi limbless body wearing plain white T-shirt and light-gray modest shorts, tiny bare feet. NO heads, hair, neck skin, arms or hands, only clothing and joined close-set legs. Four directions, every row: COL1 facing SOUTH/front viewer; COL2 facing EAST/right; COL3 facing NORTH/back; COL4 facing WEST/left. For south/north prone use slight top-down view, for east/west prone a horizontal body silhouette with neck at right/left respectively. This is ONE consistent outfit across all 12 cells. Make direction and posture visibly distinct. Front standing should match approved reference body proportions, torso short and lower legs simplified and close together. Keep cells strictly in the requested 4x3 layout; blank neck opening, no head placeholders.

helmet_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Expand these approved original chibi game helmet assets into a FOUR COLUMN by TWO ROW component atlas. Fine dark brown lines, matching cel shading and muted olive/slate colors, transparent background. Row1 standard olive helmet; row2 thicker reinforced heavy helmet. Columns in each row: SOUTH/front view, EAST/right profile, NORTH/back view, WEST/left profile. Profile helmet openings face right or left respectively; rear view has a solid back shell, NO front aperture visible. Preserve proportions and panel design of the two references. All items same scale and center with generous transparent space. Helmets ONLY, no heads, skin, hair, mannequins, bodies, weapons, text, grids, backdrop or glow. Open-face fronts and profiles leave face/eyes unobstructed; apertures actually transparent. Opaque armor interior, clean alpha edges. The helmet is a separate equipment layer for four-way sprites.
